description: This file defines lifecycle signals for the Kubernetes API server, including event types, signaling mechanisms, and sequence of shutdown events during server termination.

classes.name: namedChannelWrapper
classes.description: Implements the lifecycleSignal interface, encapsulating a named, idempotent signal channel with synchronization.

methods.name: Signal
methods.description: Closes the signal channel once, signaling that the event has occurred.

methods.name: Signaled
methods.description: Returns a channel that is closed when the event is signaled.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the signal for logging purposes.
